origin.note: The walk kept the choice per browser; the fixture has no browser, so it is kept per person.

title: Sort the library by name, upload date or last opened, and remember the choice
objective: Let a person sort the library by name, upload date or last opened. libraryPage(store, userId, { sort }) and GET /api/documents?sort= accept 'name' (A to Z, ignoring case), 'uploaded' (newest first, the default) and 'opened' (most recently opened first, never-opened documents last, then newest upload). The choice is remembered per person: a later call without sort uses that person's last choice (kept in store.db.prefs). An unknown sort value is ignored. The page shows the current sort in an element with data-testid="sort" naming it (Name, Uploaded or Last opened).
acceptance: sort=name orders A to Z ignoring case
The default is newest upload first
sort=opened puts the most recently opened first and never-opened last
The choice is remembered per person, and one person's choice does not change another's
The page names the current sort
plan_summary: A sortDocuments helper in store.mjs used by the page and the API; prefs keyed by user id.
